rules.title: blanket suppression
rules.message: Blanket clippy-grade suppressions hide quality debt across unrelated findings.
rules.fix: Suppress one rule id on one line and include a concrete reason.

rules.title: reasonless suppression
rules.message: A clippy-grade suppression without a reason is not reviewable.
rules.fix: Add reason=<why this exact finding is intentional> or remove the suppression.

rules.title: unknown suppression rule
rules.message: A suppression references a rule id that is not in the clippy-grade inventory.
rules.fix: Use a registered rule id from --list-rules or delete the stale suppression.

rules.title: duplicate import
rules.message: The same module is imported more than once in a file.
rules.fix: Keep a single import and put aliases at the use site.

rules.title: wrong-layer import
rules.message: Production std/tools code must not import sample modules, and std must not import tools.
rules.fix: Move shared code into std or a production support module.

rules.title: TCB umbrella import
rules.message: Trust-sensitive code should not pull broad prelude/everything/workflow modules.
rules.fix: Import only the explicit small modules required by the kernel or checker.

rules.title: private/generated/demo import
rules.message: Production code should not depend on private, generated, or demo-only modules.
rules.fix: Depend on a stable public module or move the dependency behind a generated boundary.

rules.title: pointless let binding
rules.message: A let binding immediately returned unchanged adds noise and can hide stale edits.
rules.fix: Inline the expression or give the binding a name that is used later.

rules.title: manual bool identity match
rules.message: Matching Bool to return the same Bool is redundant.
rules.fix: Return the original Bool expression directly.

rules.title: manual bool negation match
rules.message: Matching Bool only to flip it is verbose and obscures intent.
rules.fix: Use the bool negation helper or a direct if-not form.

rules.title: same branch expression
rules.message: Conditional or match branches compute the same expression.
rules.fix: Remove the conditional or make the distinct branch behavior explicit.

rules.title: empty append/concat no-op
rules.message: Appending an empty list or concatenating an empty list is a no-op.
rules.fix: Return the non-empty operand directly.

rules.title: identity collection transform
rules.message: Identity map/filter/fold shapes create work without changing the value.
rules.fix: Remove the transform or replace it with the intended predicate/function.

rules.title: discarded pure result
rules.message: A pure computed result is discarded, so the expression has no visible effect.
rules.fix: Remove the expression or use its result.

rules.title: self equality predicate
rules.message: Comparing a value to itself is always true for ordinary equality.
rules.fix: Remove the comparison or compare against the intended second value.

rules.title: impossible self comparison
rules.message: Strictly comparing a value with itself is impossible.
rules.fix: Remove the comparison or fix the bound variable.

rules.title: literal condition
rules.message: A branch controlled by a literal Bool leaves dead code behind.
rules.fix: Delete the unreachable branch or replace the literal with the real predicate.

rules.title: double negation
rules.message: Double negation makes boolean flow harder to read.
rules.fix: Use the original condition directly.

rules.title: nested boolean match
rules.message: Nested Bool matches are harder to maintain than direct boolean combinators.
rules.fix: Use and/or/not helpers or a single match with the meaningful cases.

rules.title: missing error branch
rules.message: A Result/Either/Validation-returning definition handles success but not the failure path.
rules.fix: Handle Left/Err/Invalid explicitly and render or propagate the typed error.

rules.title: raw fs read
rules.message: User-facing code bypasses checked filesystem reading.
rules.fix: Use fs_read_checked, fsx_read_text, or another typed FsError-returning wrapper.

rules.title: raw fs write
rules.message: User-facing code bypasses checked filesystem writing.
rules.fix: Use fs_write_checked, fsx_write_text, or a checked overwrite policy wrapper.

rules.title: raw process execution
rules.message: User-facing code invokes a process through an unchecked primitive.
rules.fix: Use process_run_checked/processx helpers so failures become typed ProcessError values.

rules.title: manual argv parsing
rules.message: Manual argv parsing bypasses the std/args and std/cli validation layer.
rules.fix: Parse arguments through std/args or std/cli and report missing/bad values.

rules.title: manual csv splitting
rules.message: Splitting CSV text by comma loses quoting and malformed-row handling.
rules.fix: Use std/csv or table helpers and surface typed parse errors.

rules.title: ignored checked result
rules.message: A checked API result is computed and discarded, losing the error path.
rules.fix: Match or bind the Either/Result/Validation and report or propagate failures.

rules.title: unchecked overwrite
rules.message: An overwrite operation is visible but not guarded by a checked policy.
rules.fix: Use checked write options or require an explicit validated overwrite flag.

rules.title: one-letter public name
rules.message: Public one-letter names make API docs and call sites unclear.
rules.fix: Use a descriptive public name and reserve short names for local binders.

rules.title: checked helper returns raw string
rules.message: A _checked public helper should not return raw String errors or raw String status.
rules.fix: Return a typed error/result and provide render/message helpers.

rules.title: error type without renderer
rules.message: An error type is present without a nearby message/code helper.
rules.fix: Add <domain>_error_message and/or <domain>_error_code helpers.

rules.title: success exit after error
rules.message: A known error branch exits or returns success status.
rules.fix: Return a nonzero exit status after printing or propagating the error.

rules.title: error printed to stdout
rules.message: Command diagnostics should not be printed to stdout.
rules.fix: Print human-readable errors to stderr and reserve stdout for machine output.

rules.title: obvious Left success
rules.message: A success-shaped value is constructed through Left, suggesting swapped Either branches.
rules.fix: Use Right for success and Left for typed errors.

rules.title: CLI main without usage path
rules.message: A CLI main using parsed arguments has no usage/help path.
rules.fix: Add usage text and show it for missing or malformed arguments.

rules.title: required argument without missing report
rules.message: A required argument is read without an obvious missing/usage error path.
rules.fix: Report CliMissing/CliUsage or propagate the typed CliError.

rules.title: command string concatenation
rules.message: Building command strings by concatenation risks shell quoting bugs.
rules.fix: Pass argv-style command parts to processx/process_run helpers.

rules.title: too many parameters
rules.message: A function with too many parameters is hard to review and call correctly.
rules.fix: Group related inputs in a record/config object or split the operation.

rules.title: too many local lets
rules.message: A definition with many local lets is accumulating multiple responsibilities.
rules.fix: Extract named helper functions or split the workflow into stages.

rules.title: deeply nested match
rules.message: Deeply nested matches hide failure paths and make exhaustiveness review difficult.
rules.fix: Flatten with small helpers, early returns, or staged validation.

rules.title: repeated string literal
rules.message: The same string literal appears repeatedly inside one definition.
rules.fix: Name the string once as a constant or typed error constructor.

rules.title: magic large Nat literal
rules.message: A large numeric literal needs a name or documented threshold.
rules.fix: Move it to a named constant with a domain-specific name.

rules.title: duplicated local helper name
rules.message: Repeated local helper definitions are usually copy-paste drift.
rules.fix: Promote the helper or give each local helper a precise distinct role.

rules.title: near-duplicate function body
rules.message: Two definitions have structurally similar bodies after binder/literal normalization.
rules.fix: Extract the shared logic or justify why the variants must stay separate.

rules.title: large definition span
rules.message: A single definition spans too many lines for reliable review.
rules.fix: Split the function into smaller checked stages.
